mapper.sql: id, username, email, password_hash, display_name, bio, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, display_name) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName})
mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.avatar_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows f1 WHERE f1.followee_id = u.id) AS follower_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = u.id) AS following_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f3 WHERE f3.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND f3.followee_id = u.id ) AS followed_by_me
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET bio = #{bio}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
